page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head and page number at the top. No marginal notes on this page; the strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

p.i:
Totius hic etenim solus vita vnica mundi est,
Quo sine (crede mihi) non venit vlla salus.

main_text.head: BREVIVS.
CAPVT I.

p.i:
Auditum refero. Deus est lux: huic sociemur.
Se patrasse negans crimina, vera negat.

2 Belle quid quis amet, quid non, advertite, erunt, mox
Antichristi. vos unctio sacra docet.

3 Christum cernemus, qui tollit Dæmonis artes.
Vitemus Cainum. cor neget esse reos.

4 Dico spiritibus non credendum esse quibusuis.
Sit perfectus amor; cogit abire metum.

5 Est invicta fides. tres sunt unum. bene credens
Accipit. haud rogites pro graviore malo.

main_text.head: Breuissimè.
main_text.l: Vt Plenum, Mendax, Similes, ne Credite, Vincit.
main_text.head: Declaratio.
main_text.p: Vt Plenum sit gaudium vestrum, hæc scribimus: v. 4. Mendax est qui dicit se nosse Dominum, & mandata eius non seruat: v. 4. Similes Deo erimus: v. 2. ne Cre-dite cuiuis spiritui. v. 1. Vincit mundum quicquid ge-nitum est ex Deo: v. 4.
main_text.head: SECUNDA IOHANNIS EPISTOLA.
main_text.p: Tractat locum de mutua dilectione in Christo. Nam ad eius exercitium hortatur Apostolo-lus hoc epistolio quandam viduam, quæ cum liberis suis veram de Christo hauserat doctri-

page.notes: Printed page 353 of IOHANNIS. The left-edge strip with small marginal text belongs to the neighbouring page and is not included. Faint show-through text in the upper background is omitted. Verse text in the Brevius section is set in italic with some roman words; the italic/roman split is approximate. The reading "Belle" in verse 2 and "Auditum" (large initial A with V) are slightly uncertain. Verse reference numbers are copied as printed.
